result.summary: The page is mostly rendered correctly, but one clear defect stands out: a loading spinner is stuck on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image even though the image and the rest of the page have fully loaded.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner (white disc with a partial green progress ring) is overlaid in the centre of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image under 'Popular right now', although the card image, title, rating and metadata are all fully rendered. The loader appears stuck or was never dismissed, covering the photo and suggesting the card is still loading.
issues.suggestion: Hide or unmount the spinner once the card image/content has finished loading (e.g., on the image's load/error callback), and make sure the loading state is reset correctly when the card data resolves.
